payload.recallText: The main character went up to Dean McGowan asking about the plans to raise tuition above the inflation rate. Dean responded with vulgar words. He then went back to the newsroom with the scoop to find the editor to pitch the story. He told him the guy fled the scene and clicked his heels in glee. Pine man also emerged from behind the late night library drop box and made a delivery, and people started dressing like him. They were wondering if Jim was pie man as well. And he said he was, to where Angela responded he should buy a beer and tell her all about it at the end.
